Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Talo...@hotmail.com wrote:
> I see there is a reprinted fame card in the sabaat reprint.

> Now the vamps controller takes the intial 3 pool loss? What the[?]

>
> Is this retroactive to the old fame cards as well or can we play them
> as is?

All cards are to be played as with the latest card text.

> Just what the heck is up with that change anyways[?]

From the RTR in which the card was errata'ed (before being reprinted
to match the errata):

Hoses the controller of the vampire instead of the Prey - which makes
more sense from a World of Darkness perspective (the controller has to
expend resources to cover up the famous one's disappearance, not the
Prey, although all suffer from the mounting questions people start
asking after an extended period.)
This removes the "watch me shoot myself" abuses, and gives combat decks
slightly improved speed, which helps in a tournament situation where the
games are timed.

> While were at it...how is rotschreck played these days?

As printed. The vampire who is the target of the aggravated
damage is sent to torpor.
